title: Furukawa Electric Power Systems suspects unauthorised access to a disaster-prevention product shipment system
date_note: Date of the company's own notice (FEPS, 26 October 2026); it says the anomaly was detected on 14 October. Security NEXT reported it on 17 November, which was the date on file until this follow-up.
summary: Furukawa Electric Power Systems, a Furukawa Electric group company, said on October 26 that after detecting an anomaly on October 14 it found suspected outside access to a shipment-management web system of its Disaster Prevention Products Division. Orderers' and delivery recipients' company names, names, addresses and phone numbers may have been viewed or taken; the number is under review. It stopped the system and related servers on the day of detection (October 14) and says no misuse has been confirmed.
plain: A Japanese manufacturer says an outsider may have accessed its shipping system and customer contact details.
exec: Customer and delivery contact data may be exposed; the company is still investigating cause and scope.
action: Furukawa Electric Power Systems warns customers to beware of calls, SMS and mail impersonating the company, its affiliates or carriers.
